activeSprint.title: Fork default branch bootstrap, Gradle mirror setup, and Graphify
activeSprint.goal: Make the 1.21 branch usable as the fork's default 1.21.1 maintenance branch, with a repo-local harness and domestic Gradle wrapper mirror.
scope: Keep branch 1.21 as the default fork branch
verification: git status reflects only intentional changes
gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties points to the chosen mirror
feature_list.json and sprint_plan.json parse as JSON
python scripts/dev/setup_graphify_local.py installs hooks and can rebuild graphify-out
exitCriteria: New sessions can find the fork target and workflow entrypoints
The wrapper no longer downloads Gradle from services.gradle.org
Graphify local automation is installable from the repo root
Build result or network blocker is recorded in progress.md
activeSprint.blocker: NeoForge build did not complete within the verification window after Maven mirror changes. Gradle wrapper mirror itself is confirmed working.
